# Autonomous Agent Instructions (G0 纠偏版)

Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md), [`BACKLOG.md`](../BACKLOG.md) and [`docs/design/G0-reference-guide.md`](../docs/design/G0-reference-guide.md) first. Execute the G0 section in order (`G0-1 → G0-2 → G2-1 → G2-2 → G2-3 → G4-2`), one commit per task. Count only real highlights via `isHighlight`; the four basic moves never count. The director may seed future-only nudges but must not rewrite past facts. New content is storylet data. Verify with `npm run verify`, update BACKLOG and CHANGELOG, commit and push to `origin main`, then continue immediately.
